howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据需求生成测试用例、分析代码覆盖率、指导红-绿-重构的 TDD 流程，并支持 Jest、Pytest 等多种测试框架。
howto.when: 当你提供源代码、覆盖率报告或需求描述，并明确要求生成测试、分析覆盖率或指导 TDD 流程时触发。

say.text: 为我的认证模块生成测试用例，代码已粘贴。
say.note: Claude 会解析代码并输出完整的测试文件。

say.text: 分析这个覆盖率报告，找出未测试的代码路径。
指导我用 TDD 实现密码验证函数，需求如下：……
say.note: Claude 会逐步引导红-绿-重构循环。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate test cases from requirements, analyze code coverage, guide the red-green-refactor TDD workflow, and support multiple testing frameworks like Jest, Pytest, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide source code, coverage reports, or requirements and explicitly ask to generate tests, analyze coverage, or guide TDD workflow.

say_en.text: Generate test cases for my authentication module, code pasted.
say_en.note: Claude will parse code and output complete test files.

say_en.text: Analyze this coverage report and find untested code paths.
say_en.note: Claude will parse LCOV/JSON/XML reports and give prioritized suggestions.

say_en.text: Guide me through TDD for a password validation function with these requirements...
say_en.note: Claude will step through red-green-refactor cycles.
